Identified the beak as black, long, and pointed.

end.parentNote: Asha practised observing animal features and linking each feature to its use. Atharv described the crow’s black, pointed beak and suggested it could help catch food. They mixed up webbed feet with the crow’s feet, and this remained at the end of the lesson. At home, show a crow and a duck picture and ask Atharv to name one beak feature and one foot feature for each.
